best_idea: A veterancy bonus that follows 3x/(1+3x) toward a per-unit cap, written under one named source so a repeat replaces the bonus instead of stacking it.
decision_why: Take the saturating curve and the replace-by-source rule for hero mastery, with cap and curve constant as catalogue data and XP only from the server ledger; reject the engine XP callin and the juno kill-XP grant.
acceptance: A server test asserts a hero where the curve reads one half gets half the catalogue cap as reach bonus, and a second grant from the same source replaces the first.
